Name: Arrbyte's Canaries
Author: Arrbyte
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=3]
[b][img]https://piskel-imgstore-b.appspot.com/img/3c6fe638-4aec-11ed-830d-a1d01cc8689a.gif[/img]﻿[/b]
[b]Content[/b]
[/size][/font]This adds a canary option to marine's shop. Lays unique eggs and brings secrets from the mines. 
Download this if you like canaries.

[b]Available in[/b]
- English
- German
- French by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/vin163/about-me?gameId=1303]vin163[/url].

[font=Arial][size=5][b]Colors to collect:[/b]
[/size][size=3]- White
- Yellow
- Red/Brown
- Yellow/Brown
- Red

Specials (not in shop):
- Void[/size][/font][size=3]
[/size]

[b][font=Verdana][size=3]Origin[/size][/font][/b]
The sound is recorded myself. The birds and chirps you hear are from my male and female birds, as well are the color schemes inspired by them.

Canaries involved in this Pack:
[list]
[*]Thanks to [i]Lora[/i] the nest builder
[*][i]Gordon[/i] the old one
[*][i]Giovanni[/i] the fat
[*][i]Elias[/i] the White
[*][i]Sandwich[/i] the…um.. sandwiching bird…
[/list]

[b][font=Verdana][size=3]Additional Drops[/size][/font][/b][b][font=Verdana][size=3]
[/size][/font][/b]Since canaries were used in the mines, their drops are mine related too! Here is a totally real quote.

[quote]Wow who knew this spotted canary brings me coal in the mornings?[/quote]

﻿- Any mods you like!

[font=Verdana][size=3][b]Requirements in 1.6[/b][/size][/font]
[b][font=Verdana][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ [/size][/font][/b]by Pathoshield

[b]Requirements in 1.5[/b]
[spoiler]If you still play in 1.5 you are free to download the 3.0.0 version from "old files" in nexus mods. This version ( 3.0.0 ) is stable and works just fine, but won't be updated with new content and skins.
To run it, you need the following: 

[url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-68#post-47274]BFAV - unofficial version[/url]
Custom Music for 1.5

Issues here it might be a bit buggy due BFAV, but if you sleep it usually recovers. Works fine multiplayer and singleplayer.

Do not forget that running BFAV at all, you unlock all chickens and BFAV animals using "Egg" with using an "Egg" in the incubator. Might offset the balancing a bit.
[/spoiler]
